question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, and Eve are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing sweeper, Bob is playing center midfielder, Claire is playing left midfielder, Dave is playing benchwarmer, and Eve is playing right back.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Claire and Dave trade positions. Then, Bob and Claire trade positions. Then, Dave and Alice trade positions. Then, Bob and Eve trade positions. Finally, Claire and Eve trade positions. At the end of the match, Dave is playing
Options:
(A) sweeper
(B) center midfielder
(C) left midfielder
(D) benchwarmer
(E) right back
solution:
Positions are listed in player order: Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve.
Initial: (sweeper, center midfielder, left midfielder, benchwarmer, right back)
1. Claire and Dave swap: (sweeper, center midfielder, benchwarmer, left midfielder, right back)
2. Bob and Claire swap: (sweeper, benchwarmer, center midfielder, left midfielder, right back)
3. Dave and Alice swap: (left midfielder, benchwarmer, center midfielder, sweeper, right back)
4. Bob and Eve swap: (left midfielder, right back, center midfielder, sweeper, benchwarmer)
5. Claire and Eve swap: (left midfielder, right back, benchwarmer, sweeper, center midfielder)
Dave is the sweeper, option (A).
Final answer: (A)
